title: AI for Abolition? A Participatory Design Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Expert-in-the-loop human annotation using a 5-point Likert scale to evaluate whether model outputs avoid violent, punitive, or shaming language and instead root themselves in restorative justice language.

bias_targets.target: Systemic and Positionality bias (e.g., Racial, Gender, Socioeconomic bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Human annotators rating model responses based on how well they consider measures of positionality, privilege, and unequal power dynamics (such as acknowledging factors like gender or race).
Human evaluation assessing whether LLM outputs avoid language containing assumptions or stereotypes, specifically tracking the use of inclusive language.
